title: NEXUS
shortDescription: Discover people and local activity nearby on a live, privacy-aware map.
fullDescription:
NEXUS is a map-first social app for discovering nearby people, events and local opportunities.

EXPLORE WHAT'S NEARBY
Open the interactive map to discover nearby activity and find people, events and local listings. Switch between Experiences and Opportunities to explore your surroundings.

CONNECT WITH PEOPLE
Send a wave, build connections and continue conversations in 1:1 chat.

MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR AREA
Find events, explore marketplace listings and stay connected with local activity.

YOUR LOCATION, YOUR CHOICE
NEXUS lets you control your map presence. Your exact coordinates are never shown to other users. Location is processed for nearby discovery, then privacy-coarsened before storage and display.

NEXUS is currently being tested. Some features may change as we improve the experience. Share feedback with the team to help us make local discovery better.
